posts.post: people who claim they don't care about trends but replace their entire wardrobe every six months are the real scammers.
you’re either someone who checks the weather three times before picking an outfit, or you’re the person shivering in a crop top because it looked good in the mirror.
stop pretending you like 'breathable' fabrics. you just like clothes that don't make you sweat through your day.
the audacity of a zipper that gets stuck halfway up your back is a personal attack from the manufacturer.
